This repository contains code (R and Python) that scrapes the example delimiter-separated table(s) from the Wikipedia page: <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delimiter-separated_values>

-   `r_csv/` contains an R script (`scrape_csv.R`) that uses `rvest` to extract table(s) and save them as CSV files.
-   `python_csv/` contains a Python script (`scrape_csv.py`) that uses `requests` + `BeautifulSoup` (for locating the tables) and `pandas` to parse and save them as CSV files.

Run the scripts to produce local CSV files.
